answer: Keep sybils stranded with an island toll, a ledge gate, and a lotus petal. Each identity lives on one island and earns influence only by crossing a ledge. Crossing costs a toll plus one lotus: a petal that regrows only after a full epoch of clean work, so a petal cannot be stockpiled or shared. The ledge toll rises with funder concentration: the k-th identity from one funder pays base times k squared, so N clones pay roughly N cubed in total tolls while splitting one island share. One honest agent pays base and one petal; a clone factory pays cubic tolls for the same single share.
